chosen_line.card: All Streams Flow to the Sea

q1_what_did_you_play: I played All Streams Flow to the Sea on Nibbit first for 9 damage, then played Twin Tides and chose Spend 6 Charge: gain 12 Block. This uses both energy, leaves Charge at 2, deals 9 damage, and blocks the telegraphed 12 damage attack.
q2_other_line_considered: I seriously considered Gyorin Formation alone because it gives 10 Block now and 6 Block at the start of next turn, but it uses both energy and deals no damage. I also briefly checked Twin Tides' Gain 5 Block option to preserve Charge, but it is worse this turn because it leaves the 12 damage attack partially unblocked.
q3_what_it_gave_up: The chosen line gave up Gyorin Formation's 6 Block at the start of next turn, gave up 6 Charge by spending it on Twin Tides, and gave up the chance to play Water's Edge for extra damage because both energy was used on All Streams Flow to the Sea and Twin Tides.
q4_different_intent: Yes. If Nibbit had telegraphed Defend or a much smaller attack, I would have prioritized damage and played All Streams Flow to the Sea plus Water's Edge for 15 total damage instead of taking 12 Block. If it had telegraphed a larger attack, I would still likely have taken block, though Gyorin Formation might have become more attractive if next-turn block mattered more.
